syllabus_topics: Dimensioning of a solar electric bicycle
Solar panel technology selection and capacity determination
Energy storage technology selection and capacity determination
Electric drive motor technology selection and capacity determination
Study of energy flow control using static electric power converters (power electronics)
Selection of converters (conversion type, reversibility, etc.)
Numerical calculation tools (Matlab, Python) for studying solar bike behavior
Electrical simulation tools (PSIM) for studying solar bike behavior
institution: Institut National Polytechnique De Grenoble — Licence Électronique-Énergie électrique-Automatique (UGA)
degree: Licence Électronique, énergie électrique, automatique, parcours EEA (2e et 3e année)
